verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's blog says users can create multiple keys per environment, each with its own access scope, optional task restrictions and an expiration date. That directly covers issuing least-privilege, time-bound credentials that could be handed to an agent. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the scope model and how to issue keys, explicit guidance on using these keys for agents or the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
